messages:
James Ortiz: Heads-up team — kicking off controlled rollout for v3.0.0-alpha in 5m. Canary targets: inference=7%, embeddings=7%. Please run preflight diffs and watch p95/p99, 5xx, and kvcache_miss. @SRE-Oncall @Lena
DeployBot: [bot] Canary created: v3.0.0-alpha -> service/inference. canary_id=canary-9876. Initial weights: 7%. Commit=b1c4d9e. Quick commands: /deploybot pin <route>=<version> | /deploybot rollback <commit> | /deploybot pause <canary-id>
Lena Torres: Got it. Running the automated preflight: diffing SLOs + recent regressions.
ObservabilityBot: Preflight SLO diff (baseline last 1h -> canary first 10m): 
- inference p95: baseline=220ms, canary=260ms (+18%)
- inference p99: baseline=480ms, canary=740ms (+54%) 
- embeds p95: baseline=190ms, canary=330ms (+74%) 
- 5xx rate: baseline=0.06%, canary=0.21% (threshold 0.15%)
- kvcache_miss_rate: baseline=2.3%, canary=4.8% 
Automated flag: embeds route breach on p95/p99 and 5xx.
SRE-Oncall: pulling tails and logs now. quick query: `metrics query --service=inference --range=15m --by=route --agg=p99,5xx,kvcache_miss`
SRE-Oncall: query result snippet: `embeds p99=790ms, 5xx=0.25%, kvcache_miss=5.1%`
James Ortiz: Oof. That p99 on embeds is worrying. Proposal: pause ramp and try a route-level pin for embeddings back to stable (v2.9.9) while we debug. Less noisy than full rollback.
Lena Torres: Agreed. I'll run the pin. Command: `/deploybot pin route=embeds version=2.9.9`
DeployBot: Command received: pin route=embeds -> 2.9.9. Pin applied. Canary remains at 7% for non-embeds.
ObservabilityBot: New snapshot (post-pin, last 5m): embeds p95=205ms, p99=260ms, 5xx=0.07%, kvcache_miss=2.7%. Metrics back near baseline.
SRE-Oncall: Traces show embed handler latencies spiking when kvcache miss + KMS envelope unwrap cold path hit. There are stepped retries from the KMS client at 100ms backoff -> amplifies tail.
Lena Torres: I'll add an action item to release notes: "canary: embeddings regression traced to KMS retry/backoff + kvcache miss. Mitigation: route pin to 2.9.9; follow-up: adjust KMS client backoff and increase kvcache warm-up in startup."
James Ortiz: Good. Keep the pin for 30m and let's not resume the full ramp until SRE signoff. If things stay stable we'll schedule a patch and re-run canary.
DeployBot: Canary paused for embeddings. To resume or rollback: `/deploybot resume canary-9876` or `/deploybot rollback b1c4d9e`.
SRE-Oncall: I'll keep an eye on KMS error budget and redis latency. Will post updates every 10m.
Lena Torres: Added entry to release notes tool: `release_notes add --release v3.0.0-alpha --section canary_incidents --note "embeds regression -> pinned route to 2.9.9; follow-up: KMS client retry tuning, cache warmup"`
James Ortiz: Thanks all. Triage channel: #incidents if this escalates. Otherwise we'll reconvene in 30m for roll decision.
